description.text:
The basic Energy cards of the Scarlet & Violet Series, the first basic Energy printed as a set of their own, with the SVE set symbol and a collection number, and the first outside Asia to print the card's name. Numbers 001-008, a plain design, came with Scarlet & Violet on 31 March 2023; 009-016, drawn like Terastal crystals, came with Stellar Crown; and 017-024, recalling the Energy of the Black & White Series, came with Black Bolt and White Flare.

Some foil versions belong to one product each: cosmos holo copies of 001-008 to 151 and parallel holo copies to Shrouded Fable, cracked ice holo copies of 009-016 to the Terapagos ex Ultra-Premium Collection and holo copies to Prismatic Evolutions, and tinsel holo copies of 017-024 to Black Bolt and White Flare.
